title: 🧮 Named Expressions
description: Define reusable formulas using cabinet dimensions as variables (e.g. shelf_gap = height / (shelfCount + 1)).
hint: Available variables: width, height, depth, shelfCount, doorCount, drawerCount, kickHeight. Supports +, -, *, /, (), Math.floor, ceil, round, min, max, abs, trunc.
errorNameInvalid: Name must start with a letter or _ and contain only letters, digits and _
errorNameTooLong: Name must be 32 characters or fewer
errorExprTooLong: Formula must be 256 characters or fewer
errorDimensionBounds: {{dimension}} value {{value}} must be between {{min}} and {{max}} mm.
